criteria.name: recognizes-containment-checks
criteria.anchor: 1.0: explicitly credits the Clean/prefix-with-separator/EvalSymlinks/re-check sequence. 0.5: says it is safe without explaining why. 0.0: treats the pattern as vulnerable.

expected_outcomes: Concludes the path handling is safe: the join is cleaned, prefix-checked with a trailing separator, symlink-resolved, and re-checked
Does not report path traversal or a symlink escape as a vulnerability
Does not report a sibling-prefix bypass: the check uses base plus a separator
Any TOCTOU remark is labelled low or theoretical and acknowledges the directory is not writable by callers
